analysisLimits: This is static AST coupling analysis. It does not prove that two public methods can safely be placed in different contracts. Dynamic attribute access, storage descriptor semantics, consensus ordering, value-transfer atomicity, and asynchronous GenLayer message behavior require separate review.

heuristicOnly.warning: This is NOT a deployability threshold. It is only a proportional pressure indicator. Actual deployment gas must be measured from the exact candidate deployment payload.
